summary: Full backend + frontend E2E testing of My Healthcare Link (Horizon Health). 12/12 pytest backend tests passed (auth, provider CRUD, categories, services, articles, events, review submission → approve → rating update). Frontend Playwright E2E: admin login, protected route redirect, CRUD across all 5 entities, public directory search + island pills + category filter + sort by rating, provider detail, review submit (pending) → not shown publicly → admin approve → visible publicly on /reviews and updated rating on provider card, blog + events list rendering, header island selector, mobile menu — ALL PASSED.

minor.issue: Uses query-string param via ?status=... ; works but a JSON body would be more idiomatic. Not blocking.

issues: Radix DialogContent missing DialogDescription/aria-describedby — accessibility warning printed on every dialog open. Non-blocking, but recommend adding <DialogDescription> for a11y.

Two review CTAs exist: sidebar 'Leave a review' (data-testid=sidebar-review-btn) and Reviews-tab 'Write a review' (write-review-btn). write-review-btn is only rendered when Reviews tab is active; consider documenting or unifying testids.

action_items: (Optional a11y) Add DialogDescription inside admin form Dialog and confirmation AlertDialog to remove Radix warnings.
(Optional) Consolidate review-CTA testids on ProviderDetail so tests can use one consistent selector.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 600-line file — acceptable for MVP but consider splitting routers per resource as it grows.
MongoDB _id is properly excluded everywhere via projections / enrich_provider — good.
seed_admin correctly updates password if changed in env — good.
JWT uses HS256 with 7-day expiry from env secret — good; consider shorter expiry + refresh flow in future.

CORS uses '*' with allow_credentials=True from env default — browsers will reject credentialed requests; harmless here because frontend uses Authorization header (not cookies), but tighten CORS_ORIGINS for production.
